options.denominator: None; total crashes accumulated over the period
options.reason: Raw totals give a direct view of how many reported crashes occurred on each weekday over the requested period.
options.answer: Across 2013–2025, Friday had the most reported crashes (338,800) and Sunday the fewest (257,544).

options.reason: Shares make each weekday's contribution to the full 13-year crash total easy to compare as parts of one whole.
options.answer: Friday accounted for the largest share, 15.89% of crashes, while Sunday accounted for the smallest, 12.08%.

options.metric: Average police-reported crashes per calendar occurrence of the weekday
options.denominator: Calendar dates of that weekday from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31 (678 or 679 dates, depending on weekday)
options.reason: Normalizing by the number of calendar occurrences accounts for the small differences in how often each weekday falls in the 13-year span.
options.answer: The average was highest on Friday at 499.7 crashes per Friday and lowest on Sunday at 379.9 per Sunday.
